mapper.sql: status_id AS statusId, group_key AS groupKey, group_name AS groupName, phase_key AS phaseKey, snapshot_policy AS snapshotPolicy, interval_ms AS intervalMs, max_ticks AS maxTicks, priority, extend::text AS extendJson
mapper.select: SELECT FROM public.status_modifier_groups WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY status_id, priority, group_key
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.status_modifier_groups (game_id, status_id, group_key, start_version_id, end_version_id, group_name, phase_key, snapshot_policy, interval_ms, max_ticks, priority, extend, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{statusId}, #{groupKey}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{groupName}, #{phaseKey}, #{snapshotPolicy}, #{intervalMs}, #{maxTicks}, #{priority}, COALESCE(CAST(#{extendJson} AS jsonb), '{}'::jsonb), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, status_id, group_key) DO UPDATE SET start_version_id = EXCLUDED.start_version_id, end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, group_name = EXCLUDED.group_name, phase_key = EXCLUDED.phase_key, snapshot_policy = EXCLUDED.snapshot_policy, interval_ms = EXCLUDED.interval_ms, max_ticks = EXCLUDED.max_ticks, priority = EXCLUDED.priority, extend = EXCLUDED.extend, updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO public.status_modifier_groups_log (game_id, status_id, group_key, start_version_id, end_version_id, group_name, phase_key, snapshot_policy, interval_ms, max_ticks, priority, extend) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{statusId}, #{groupKey}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{groupName}, #{phaseKey}, #{snapshotPolicy}, #{intervalMs}, #{maxTicks}, #{priority}, COALESCE(CAST(#{extendJson} AS jsonb), '{}'::jsonb)) ON CONFLICT (game_id, status_id, group_key, start_version_id) DO UPDATE SET end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, group_name = EXCLUDED.group_name, phase_key = EXCLUDED.phase_key, snapshot_policy = EXCLUDED.snapshot_policy, interval_ms = EXCLUDED.interval_ms, max_ticks = EXCLUDED.max_ticks, priority = EXCLUDED.priority, extend = EXCLUDED.extend
